headline: RTX 5090 shipment vanishes at a Brazilian airport
dek: Distributor Oderço puts the loss at about 2.5 million reais, according to TecMundo.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Two pallets go missing
body: A shipment of Zotac RTX 5090 cards vanished on arrival at Guarulhos, according to distributor Oderço and TecMundo.
The company puts the loss at about 2.5 million reais at cost price, TecMundo says.

points.t: Does not know the cause and criticizes the silence (Canaltech).
Says it told authorities and began compensation (TecMundo).
First lost shipment in over 38 years (Canaltech).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: A card AI keeps hot
body: The RTX 5090 averages 35,000 reais at Brazilian retail, according to Canaltech and TecMundo.
Less than a year ago, before the AI boom, it cost under 15,000 reais, Canaltech says.

stat.cap: pallets vanished at Guarulhos, TecMundo says

items.t: Oderço did not say how many cards were on the pallets.
There is still no explanation for the disappearance.
GRU awaits the client's paperwork, TecMundo says.

caption.hook: Two pallets of RTX 5090 cards vanished on landing at Guarulhos airport, distributor Oderço says.
body: According to TecMundo and Canaltech, distributor Oderço puts the loss at about 2.5 million reais at cost price. The company says it does not know what caused the disappearance and did not say how many cards were in the shipment.

GRU Airport told TecMundo it reported the case to authorities and gave compensation instructions on October 14. According to Canaltech, the RTX 5090 averages 35,000 reais at retail, up from under 15,000 reais a year ago, because of AI demand.
